6. Standardise variables

pca_scaled <- scale(pca_data)

7. Run PCA

pca_res <- prcomp(pca_scaled, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
summary(pca_res)
Importance of components:
                          PC1    PC2    PC3     PC4     PC5     PC6     PC7
Standard deviation     1.7818 1.4392 1.1389 0.61326 0.57858 0.53638 0.48967
Proportion of Variance 0.3968 0.2589 0.1621 0.04701 0.04184 0.03596 0.02997
Cumulative Proportion  0.3968 0.6558 0.8179 0.86493 0.90677 0.94273 0.97271
                           PC8
Standard deviation     0.46727
Proportion of Variance 0.02729
Cumulative Proportion  1.00000

8. Eigenvalues and explained variance

eigenvals <- pca_res$sdev^2
explained_var <- eigenvals/sum(eigenvals) * 100
cum_var <- cumsum(explained_var)
eigen_table <- data.frame(Component = paste0("PC", 1:length(eigenvals)), Eigenvalue = eigenvals,
    Variance_Percent = explained_var, Cumulative_Percent = cum_var)
print(eigen_table)
  Component Eigenvalue Variance_Percent Cumulative_Percent
1       PC1  3.1747881        39.684852           39.68485
2       PC2  2.0713447        25.891809           65.57666
3       PC3  1.2971883        16.214854           81.79151
4       PC4  0.3760898         4.701123           86.49264
5       PC5  0.3347555         4.184443           90.67708
6       PC6  0.2877085         3.596356           94.27344
7       PC7  0.2397811         2.997263           97.27070
8       PC8  0.2183440         2.729300          100.00000
kaiser_components <- eigen_table$Component[eigen_table$Eigenvalue > 1]
print(kaiser_components)
[1] "PC1" "PC2" "PC3"
fviz_eig(pca_res, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 100), barfill = "steelblue", barcolor = "black") +
    ggtitle("Scree Plot - Customer Satisfaction PCA")

plot(eigenvals, type = "b", pch = 19, xlab = "Principal Component", ylab = "Eigenvalue",
    main = "Scree Plot")

abline(h = 1, col = "red", lty = 2)

10. Save selected components for further analysis

Example: retain first 2 components (adjust based on scree/Kaiser)

selected_pcs <- data.frame(Customer_ID = data$Customer_ID, pca_res$x[, 1:3])
write.csv(selected_pcs, "selected_pca_components.csv", row.names = FALSE)

11. Component loadings

loadings <- pca_res$rotation
print(round(loadings[, 1:3], 2))

Show largest absolute loadings for first two PCs

loadings_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
    pivot_longer(-Variable, names_to = "PC", values_to = "Loading") %>%
    group_by(PC) %>%
    slice_max(abs(Loading), n = 3) %>%
    arrange(PC, desc(abs(Loading)))
print(loadings_df)
